title: Type-Theoretic Contracts for Neural Network Behavior: A Prototype Testbed

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: The chain from type-theoretic contracts to alignment is plausible but indirect. Testing simple behavioral contracts on a text classifier is a reasonable first step, but the link between contract satisfaction rates and actual alignment guarantees remains speculative at this scale.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training a GPT-2 scale model on text classification is feasible with medium compute. Defining simple behavioral contracts and measuring satisfaction rates is conceptually straightforward for CS students. The type theory framing may require mentor guidance but the actual experiment is accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-scoped: define contracts, train one model with and without constraints, measure satisfaction rates on 500 inputs. Clear deliverable (contract satisfaction comparison table). Achievable in 30 hours if contracts are kept simple.
